source: G3/R3 acceptance route (docs/g3_consumer_design.md 6.1, slice S3). GENERATED by tools/rg_route_gen from the home road graph (roads.graph layer, drivable classes v1) - do not edit by hand, edit data/routes/home_g3_junctions.gen.json and regenerate. Spawn: the R2.2 home spawn on Engelsruhe (same as home_r1_drive). Steps: via the 12-node junction at OSM node 94147307, then B 8 over the north-west carriageway bridge (OSM way 1096866569, B8 bridge #4), both directions over the L 3014 bridge (way 14799333, via the roads either side of it), the B 8 south-east carriageway bridge (way 1096866567). The two B 8 carriageways are separate oneway ways, so crossing the structure in both directions is one crossing of each. Distinct junction clusters (>= 3 drivable neighbours, nodes within 30 m merged) are listed with their OSM node ids so a later geo2map pin bump can re-resolve them.
